description: This file manages security-related functionalities including password hashing, password verification, JWT token creation, and decoding/validation within a backend authentication system.

methods.name: str get_password_hash(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt, ensuring the input is a non-empty string.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hashed password, returning True if they match.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, expires_delta_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with a subject, optional extra claims, and expiration based on settings or override.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token, raising JWTError if invalid or expired.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, expires_del/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, expires_delta_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
